on_battle_start: Welcome to Frostfae. The cherry blossoms freeze, but our hearts stay warm.
Let the snow witness a true battle of ice and grace.
on_battle_won: The frost has claimed another challenger. Come back when you're ready.
Even the strongest flame melts before Frostfae's chill.
on_battle_lost: You melted right through my defenses. Well fought, trainer.
The floating island trembles with your victory. Take the badge.
